title: Subjectivity-Intersection Braid Quantum Gravity: A Constructive Refutation of Objectivist Primacy from Source-Derived Quantum Dynamics to the Einstein Limit
description: We develop Subjectivity-Intersection Braid Quantum Gravity as a candidate theory in which a public spacetime carrier is generated by intersections of nonidentical, standpoint-bearing Braid processes rather than assumed as an ontologically prior container. In one fixed pointed-Braid model, the finite source supplies an operational four-direction event cylinder, fixed-model matter routing, the relative factor 3/5, a Lorentz carrier, source-selected long-wavelength matter dynamics, continuous metric and nonmetricity tensors, a unique typed metric solder, Hilbert stress, an on-shell Ward identity, and a scoped Einstein equation G_mn=(3/5)T_mn. The flat quadratic limit is the massless Fierz-Pauli gauge class with two physical helicities. The result is restricted to a declared long-wavelength, local, second-order, formally self-adjoint, conservative class. Full finite Lorentzian quantum backreaction, four-component discrete Ward balance, ultraviolet completion, physical-unit calibration, Standard Model embedding, and empirical validation remain open. The construction refutes the universal necessity of objectivist primacy; it does not refute mind-independent reality, establish consciousness, or show that nature realizes the model.
